top_signals.title: North Korea calls U.S. claims it was behind Binance hack ‘a grave political provocation’
top_signals.summary: Kim Yo Jong, the powerful sister of the North Korean leader, called the allegations "absurd rhetoric and nothing new."
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Japan’s new disaster agency calls on public to prepare for disasters
top_signals.summary: Goshi Hosono, who became the first chief of the agency, noted that there are limits to what the government can do in the event of a massive disaster.

top_signals.title: Ports of Indiana Makes November 1 Leadership Transition
top_signals.summary: Jody Peacock concluded his service as Chief Executive Officer of Ports of Indiana effective November 1. On that date, Ports of Indiana Chief Operating Officer Dave Parrott and Chief Financial Officer Erica Jackson began serving as the organization’s interim leadership team.
